segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַבְּכוֹר וְהַמַּעֲשֵׂר וְהַפֶּסַח – קָדָשִׁים קַלִּים – שְׁחִיטָתָן בְּכׇל מָקוֹם בָּעֲזָרָה; וְדָמָן טָעוּן מַתָּנָה אֶחָת, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁיִּתֵּן כְּנֶגֶד הַיְסוֹד.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The firstborn» offering, «the» animal «tithe» offering, «and the Paschal offering are offerings of lesser sanctity. Their slaughter is anywhere in the» Temple «courtyard, and their blood requires one placement, provided that» the priest «places it» so that the blood goes «on the base» of the altar.

segments.he: שִׁינָּה בַּאֲכִילָתָן. הַבְּכוֹר – נֶאֱכָל לַכֹּהֲנִים, וְהַמַּעֲשֵׂר – לְכׇל אָדָם; וְנֶאֱכָלִין בְּכׇל הָעִיר, בְּכׇל מַאֲכָל, לִשְׁנֵי יָמִים וְלַיְלָה אֶחָד. הַפֶּסַח – אֵינוֹ נֶאֱכָל אֶלָּא בַּלַּיְלָה, וְאֵינוֹ נֶאֱכָל אֶלָּא עַד חֲצוֹת, וְאֵינוֹ נֶאֱכָל אֶלָּא לִמְנוּיָו, וְאֵינוֹ נֶאֱכָל אֶלָּא צָלִי.
segments.en: The halakha «differs with regard to their consumption. The firstborn» offering «is eaten by the priests, and the» animal «tithe» offer-ing is eaten «by any person,» i.e., any ritually pure Jew. «And they are eaten throughout the city» of Jerusalem, prepared «in any» manner of «food» preparation, «for two days and one night. The Paschal offering is eaten only at night, and it is eaten only until midnight, and it is eaten only by its registrants,» i.e., those who registered in advance to partake of the offering, «and it is eaten only roasted,» not prepared in any other manner.
